title: Rebuild expired draft app and add contact email

requirements.summary: Rebuild and redeploy the existing draft application in its current state so it is accessible for review
acceptanceCriteria: The application builds and deploys successfully without errors.
All existing sections (hero, content sections, documents, property details, header, footer) render correctly.

file_operations.description: Review and verify the main app structure composes all sections correctly. Ensure hero, content sections, documents, property details, header, and footer are all rendered. No functional changes needed; validate existing structure is intact for successful rebuild.
Review and verify the header component renders correctly with navigation and mobile menu functionality. No functional changes needed; validate existing structure is intact for successful rebuild.
Review and verify the footer component renders correctly with disclaimer, copyright, and caffeine.ai attribution. Prepare this file for the contact email addition in REQ-2.
Review and verify the documents section renders correctly with document cards and icons. No functional changes needed; validate existing structure is intact for successful rebuild.

Review and verify the property details section renders correctly with structured categories, records, cards, accordions, and badges. No functional changes needed; validate existing structure is intact for successful rebuild.

requirements.summary: Add contact email khutiaashim@gmail.com as a clickable mailto link in the footer
acceptanceCriteria: The email address khutiaashim@gmail.com is visible on the page.
The email is rendered as a clickable mailto:khutiaashim@gmail.com link.
The contact email is labeled clearly (e.g., 'Contact:' or 'Email:') so visitors understand its purpose.
The email link is styled consistently with the existing site theme.

file_operations.description: Add the contact email khutiaashim@gmail.com as a clickable mailto link in the footer. Place it prominently above or within the existing disclaimer/copyright section. Wrap the email in a mailto: anchor tag with clear labeling (e.g., 'Contact:' or 'Email:'). Style the link consistently with the existing footer theme using appropriate text color classes from the Tailwind config. Ensure the email is easily visible and accessible to visitors.
